notes: ACCESS: www.conforama.fr sits behind Cloudflare and 403s plain requests. Reached with curl_cffi impersonation - safari18_0_ios and chrome124 both returned 200 (as recorded in the prior Home-Decor pass); some paths (robots.txt, sitemap-categories.xml) only yielded to safari18_0_ios. r.jina.ai was itself under a Cloudflare challenge and was not needed. ROBOTS: robots.txt blocks '*' but has an explicit '# RITM0037413 Ouverture LLMs' block naming Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User and ClaudeBot followed by 'Allow: /', so Claude agents are permitted; only /recherche-conforama*, /*query=* and similar search URLs are disallowed and none were used. TREE: the full category tree was taken from two independent sources and merged - the homepage SSR React-Server-Component payload (473 /c/<code> nodes) and https://www.conforama.fr/sitemap-categories.xml (519 nodes); union = 520 nodes, and the sitemap added 47 that the mega-menu omitted (all inspected). URL shape is /<department>/<section>/<leaf>/c/<6-digit code>; the 2-digit department and 4-digit section pages were fetched and confirmed to carry no product grid at all, so they are pure landing pages and are emitted here only as grouping rows. QTY METHOD (Rule 1): every qty is the rendered listing header 'N produits' read from the page's own HTML text. It was independently corroborated on every single row by the SSR root PLP object {"nbPages":N,...,"productCount":M,"canonicalUri":"/H-<code>/I-Page1_60"} - header == productCount on all 78 rows - and by the exhaustion identity ceil(productCount/60)==nbPages (page size 60, confirmed by the canonicalUri suffix), which held exactly on all 78 rows. Twelve rows were re-fetched cache-cold in a second pass and all twelve returned identical numbers, so there is no session drift. The suspiciously round 60 on Complete Bedroom Sets was checked by exhaustion: /I-Page2_60 renders zero product tiles, so 60 is the true total. Counts are large because they include Conforama's own stock plus its Mirakl marketplace inventory; that is what the category URL itself reports. DE-DUPLICATION: canonicalUri was used as the identity key. Dropped as aliases/filters of another node: structure-de-banquette-bz (020321) and structure-de-banquette-clic-cac (020322), both canonical to H-020301; canape-simili (020116), canonical to a revetement facet of H-020117. Dropped as exact duplicate listings (identical totals and 60/60 identical page-1 product IDs): table-de-cuisine (040103) == table (010213) at 19080, and rangement-deco/coffre-et-malle (051201) == petit-rangement/coffre-et-malle (010908) at 763. Dropped as near-duplicates: chaise-de-cuisine (040104, 59/60 shared IDs with chaise 010112), rangement-deco/etagere (051202, 54/60 shared with sejour/etagere 010214) and rangement/bibliotheque (010903, 49/60 shared with bibliotheque-et-vitrine 010205). Garden nodes 090101/090110/090111 were overlap-tested and share zero page-1 IDs, so all three are kept. EXCLUDED as rollups or filter pages (section 3): tous-les-canapes (020117), tous-les-fauteuils (020103), toutes-nos-cuisines (040601, arithmetically confirmed as the rollup 3487+83+19+4=3593), canape-cuir (020114) / canape-tissu (020115) / canape-simili (020116) as upholstery-material filters, canape-made-in-france (020403) as an origin filter, nos-series-chambre (030806) as a collection page, and the size-based 'Par Taille' section (its only product-type child, canape-modulable, is kept under Sofas). EXCLUDED as not furniture, after reading actual product titles: porte-revue (010108 - sample was dominated by basement windows, security grilles and brochure display stands), accessoires-de-sejour (010209 - lighting, mirrors and loose table tops), pouf-et-coussin-de-jardin (090109 - overwhelmingly outdoor cushions, floor cushions and pet cushions), meuble-et-support-tv (080103 - dominated by TV wall mounts, and it shares only 4/60 page-1 IDs with the real Meuble TV node 020105 which is kept), lit-parapluie-nomade (060503 - travel cots and travel mattresses filed under baby outings/safety). EXCLUDED by standing rule: all mattresses and bedding (matelas 030101/030103/030106/030141, literie-de-relaxation, sommier-et-cadre-a-lattes 030102 as a bed base, all textile-literie), bed parts (pied-de-lit 030109 bed legs), under-bed drawer options (tiroir-de-lit 010405 and tiroir-de-lit-enfant 060108 - sold as bed options, i.e. components), sofa covers and seat accessories (020104, 020203, 020323, 020324, 020407), standalone storage goods (boite-de-rangement 010909, accessoires-de-rangement 010914, rangement-deco baskets and boxes 051203/051204), umbrella stands (011204), accessory junk nodes (010407, 060117, 090112), kitchen worktops (plan-de-travail 040704) and named kitchen ranges (040706-040722, which are marketing collections), made-to-measure kitchen services (040602/040603/040604), bathroom fixtures (vasque-et-lavabo 010714, colonne-et-paroi-de-douche 010713, baignoire-et-douche 090806, wc 010715 and all bathroom accessories), garden sheds and shade structures (090709, 090106, 090503, 090504), barbecues (090201), game tables (091001/091002), ironing boards (070706), and the whole appliance, electronics, toy, decor, lighting, mirror and textile side of the catalogue.
